description: PWA implementing the classic 100 Pushups training program - a 6-week progressive plan to build up to 100 consecutive pushups. Polish language only.

requirements.description: All UI text displayed in Polish language
steps_to_verify: Open the app in a browser
Verify all buttons, labels, headings, and messages are in Polish
Navigate through all screens (home, test, workout, progress)
Confirm no English text appears in the UI

requirements.description: App uses IndexedDB for persistent local storage
steps_to_verify: Complete the initial fitness test
Open browser DevTools > Application > IndexedDB
Verify a database exists with user data
Close and reopen the browser
Confirm data persists after browser restart

requirements.description: App works offline after initial load
steps_to_verify: Load the app with network connection
Enable airplane mode or disable network in DevTools
Refresh the page
Verify app loads and functions without network
Complete a workout while offline
Verify data is saved locally

requirements.description: User can take initial fitness test to determine starting level
steps_to_verify: Launch app for the first time (clear storage if needed)
Verify app prompts for initial fitness test
See instructions explaining to do maximum pushups in one set
Enter number of pushups completed
Submit the test result

requirements.description: Test results correctly assign one of 5 levels
steps_to_verify: Complete test with 5 pushups - verify Level 1 assigned
Complete test with 8 pushups - verify Level 2 assigned
Complete test with 15 pushups - verify Level 3 assigned
Complete test with 23 pushups - verify Level 4 assigned
Complete test with 30 pushups - verify Level 5 assigned

requirements.description: User can retake the initial fitness test from settings
steps_to_verify: Complete initial test and start program
Navigate to settings or profile screen
Find and tap 'Powtórz test' (Retake test) option
Complete the test again with different result
Verify new level is assigned and program resets

requirements.description: Program consists of 6 weeks with 3 workouts per week
steps_to_verify: Complete initial test
View program overview or calendar
Verify 6 weeks are displayed
Verify each week shows 3 workout days
Confirm total of 18 workouts in the program

requirements.description: Each workout has 5 sets with level-appropriate rep targets
steps_to_verify: Start a workout session
Verify exactly 5 sets are displayed
Verify each set shows target rep count
Confirm rep targets match the assigned level
Verify final set is marked as 'max' (exhaustion test)

requirements.description: Rep targets increase progressively each week
steps_to_verify: View workout plan for Week 1 Day 1
Note the total target reps
View workout plan for Week 3 Day 1
Verify total target reps are higher than Week 1
View workout plan for Week 6 Day 1
Verify total target reps are highest

requirements.description: User can start today's scheduled workout
steps_to_verify: Open app on a workout day
See current workout displayed on home screen
Tap 'Rozpocznij trening' (Start workout) button
Verify workout screen opens with first set

requirements.description: User can log actual reps completed for each set
steps_to_verify: Start a workout
Complete first set
Enter actual number of reps performed
Tap to confirm/submit the set
Verify entered value is saved and displayed
Repeat for all 5 sets

requirements.description: Workout is marked complete after finishing all sets
steps_to_verify: Start and complete all 5 sets of a workout
Verify completion screen appears
Return to home screen
Verify workout shows as completed (checkmark or similar)
View calendar/progress and confirm workout day is marked done

requirements.description: Final set of each workout is an exhaustion test (do maximum reps)
steps_to_verify: Start a workout and progress to set 5
Verify set 5 shows 'max' or 'do maksimum' instead of fixed target
Verify UI encourages doing as many reps as possible
Enter a high number (e.g., 50) and confirm it's accepted
Verify the actual reps are logged, not capped

requirements.description: Rep input is prefilled with target number for the set
steps_to_verify: Start a workout
Complete first set
Verify input field shows target rep count as default value
Verify user can modify the prefilled value
For max set (set 5), verify input is empty or shows previous max

requirements.description: User can skip waiting period and start next workout immediately
steps_to_verify: Complete a workout for the day
Return to home screen showing 'workout done today' message
Verify a 'Skip wait' or 'Następny trening' button is available
Tap the button to start next scheduled workout
Verify the next day's workout begins without waiting

requirements.description: Rest timer appears between sets with countdown
steps_to_verify: Start a workout
Complete first set and submit reps
Verify rest timer screen appears automatically
Verify countdown timer is displayed (e.g., 60 seconds)
Watch timer count down in real-time

requirements.description: Rest duration varies based on workout difficulty (60/90/120 seconds)
steps_to_verify: Start an early-week workout
Verify rest timer shows 60 seconds
Start a mid-program workout with higher reps
Verify rest timer shows 90 seconds
Start a late-program difficult workout
Verify rest timer shows 120 seconds

requirements.description: Audio notification plays when rest period ends
steps_to_verify: Ensure device volume is on
Start a workout and complete a set
Wait for rest timer to reach zero
Verify an audio sound plays when timer ends
Verify sound is distinct and noticeable

requirements.description: User can skip rest timer early
steps_to_verify: Complete a set and enter rest period
Verify 'Pomiń' (Skip) button is visible
Tap skip button before timer ends
Verify next set appears immediately
Confirm no audio plays when skipped

requirements.description: User can pause rest timer
steps_to_verify: Complete a set and enter rest period
Verify pause button is visible
Tap pause when timer shows 30 seconds remaining
Verify countdown stops
Wait 10 seconds and verify timer still shows ~30 seconds
Tap resume and verify countdown continues

requirements.description: Calendar view shows completed and upcoming workouts
steps_to_verify: Complete at least 2 workouts
Navigate to progress/calendar screen
Verify completed workout days are marked (e.g., green checkmark)
Verify upcoming workout days are visible but unmarked
Verify current day is highlighted

requirements.description: Chart displays total reps over time
steps_to_verify: Complete at least 3 workouts on different days
Navigate to progress screen
Verify a line or bar chart is displayed
Verify X-axis shows dates or workout numbers
Verify Y-axis shows rep counts
Confirm data points match logged workout totals

requirements.description: Current week and day are clearly indicated
steps_to_verify: View home screen
Verify current week number is displayed (e.g., 'Tydzień 2')
Verify current day within week is shown (e.g., 'Dzień 1 z 3')
Verify next workout date is visible if not today

requirements.description: Overall program completion percentage is shown
steps_to_verify: Complete 3 workouts (3 of 18 total)
View progress screen
Verify completion percentage shows approximately 17%
Complete 3 more workouts
Verify percentage updates to approximately 33%

requirements.description: Progress displayed in compact format: T: 1/6, D: 1/3, P: 2
steps_to_verify: View progress screen
Verify week shown as 'T: X/6' (e.g., 'T: 1/6' for week 1)
Verify day shown as 'D: X/3' (e.g., 'D: 1/3' for day 1)
Verify attempt shown as 'P: X' (e.g., 'P: 2' for attempt 2)
Confirm old verbose format 'Tydzień X - Próba Y, Dzień Z z 3' is replaced

requirements.description: Current week in progress tab links to home screen
steps_to_verify: Navigate to progress screen
Find the current week indicator
Verify it is tappable/clickable
Tap the current week
Verify navigation to home screen

requirements.description: Option to repeat week appears after failing to complete workout
steps_to_verify: Start a workout
Intentionally log fewer reps than target in 3+ sets
Complete the workout
Verify prompt appears suggesting to repeat the week
Verify options to 'Powtórz tydzień' or 'Kontynuuj' are shown

requirements.description: User can manually choose to repeat a week from progress screen
steps_to_verify: Complete at least one workout in current week
Navigate to progress screen
Find current week section
Tap 'Powtórz tydzień' (Repeat week) option
Confirm the action
Verify week resets to Day 1

requirements.description: Repeat attempts are tracked and displayed
steps_to_verify: Repeat a week once
View progress or week header
Verify it shows 'Tydzień 2 - Próba 2' (Week 2 - Attempt 2)
Repeat the same week again
Verify it updates to 'Próba 3'

requirements.description: Previous attempt stats are visible when repeating a week
steps_to_verify: Complete week 2 with logged reps
Repeat week 2
Start first workout of repeated week
Verify previous attempt's reps are shown for comparison
Complete set and verify you can see 'Poprzednio: X' (Previously: X)

requirements.description: Visual feedback confirms week repeat action
steps_to_verify: Navigate to progress screen
Tap 'Powtórz tydzień' button
Verify immediate visual feedback (toast, animation, or screen update)
Verify home screen reflects reset to Day 1 of current week
Verify progress screen updates to show new attempt number

requirements.description: App has clear navigation between main screens
steps_to_verify: Open the app
Verify navigation bar or menu is visible
Navigate to home/dashboard screen
Navigate to progress/calendar screen
Navigate to settings screen
Verify current screen is indicated in navigation

requirements.description: Home screen shows next workout preview
steps_to_verify: Open app (not during active workout)
View home screen
Verify next scheduled workout is displayed
Verify workout details shown: week, day, number of sets
Verify target total reps are visible

requirements.description: App can be installed on mobile device home screen
steps_to_verify: Open app in mobile browser (Chrome/Safari)
Verify install prompt appears or use browser menu
Select 'Add to Home Screen' or 'Install'
Confirm installation
Open app from home screen icon
Verify app opens in standalone mode (no browser UI)

requirements.description: App displays correct name and icon when installed
steps_to_verify: Install PWA on device
Check home screen
Verify app name shows '100 Pushups' or '100 Pompek'
Verify app icon is the correct design
Open app and verify splash screen matches theme

requirements.description: Modern, bold visual style appealing to Stefan (15-year-old boy)
steps_to_verify: Open the app and review overall aesthetic
Verify dark theme or high-contrast color scheme is used
Verify bold, energetic colors (e.g., electric blue, neon green, orange accents)
Verify clean, minimal layout without clutter
Verify typography is bold and modern (not childish or corporate)
Verify app displays personalized greeting with Stefan's name

requirements.description: Personalized motivational UI for Stefan
steps_to_verify: Verify home screen greets Stefan by name (e.g., 'Cześć Stefan!')
Verify motivational messages use Stefan's name
Complete a workout and verify satisfying completion animation
Verify progress indicators feel rewarding (progress bars, streaks)
Verify achievement moments have visual impact (e.g., confetti, glow effects)

requirements.description: Fitness/athletic visual theme
steps_to_verify: Review app icons and imagery
Verify design evokes strength and fitness (not generic or bland)
Verify buttons and controls feel tactile and responsive
Verify overall vibe matches popular fitness apps (Nike, Freeletics style)

requirements.description: Home screen header is compact to maximize phone screen space
steps_to_verify: Open app on mobile device or mobile viewport
Verify header area takes minimal vertical space
Verify greeting, title, and progress info are condensed
Verify more screen space is available for workout preview and actions
Compare before/after to confirm reduced header height

requirements.description: Test that all UI text is in Polish
steps_to_verify: Create test that renders each screen component
Verify no English text appears in rendered output
Check button labels, headings, and messages are Polish

requirements.description: Test IndexedDB data persistence
steps_to_verify: Create test for saveData and getData functions
Verify data round-trips correctly
Test default data is returned when no data exists

requirements.description: Test initial fitness test flow
steps_to_verify: Render InitialTest component
Verify instructions are displayed
Simulate entering pushup count and submitting
Verify onComplete callback is called with correct level

requirements.description: Test level assignment from pushup count
steps_to_verify: Test getLevelFromTest(5) returns 1
Test getLevelFromTest(8) returns 2
Test getLevelFromTest(15) returns 3
Test getLevelFromTest(23) returns 4
Test getLevelFromTest(30) returns 5

requirements.description: Test program structure (6 weeks, 3 days)
steps_to_verify: Verify PROGRAM has 5 levels
Verify each level has 6 weeks
Verify each week has 3 days
Verify each day has 5 sets

requirements.description: Test that final set is always max (-1)
steps_to_verify: For each level, week, and day
Verify last set value is -1
Test isMaxSet() function returns true for -1

requirements.description: Test progressive rep increase across weeks
steps_to_verify: For each level, compare week 1 to week 6
Verify total target reps increase over time
Use getTargetReps() to calculate totals

requirements.description: Test WorkoutScreen renders correctly
steps_to_verify: Render WorkoutScreen with mock data
Verify set progress is displayed
Verify target reps are shown
Verify input field is present

requirements.description: Test rep logging in WorkoutScreen
steps_to_verify: Render WorkoutScreen
Enter reps in input field
Submit the set
Verify completed sets list updates

requirements.description: Test workout completion callback
steps_to_verify: Complete all 5 sets in WorkoutScreen
Verify onComplete is called with WorkoutRecord
Verify record contains correct week, day, sets data

requirements.description: Test rest timer appears between sets
steps_to_verify: Complete a set in WorkoutScreen
Verify rest timer screen appears
Verify countdown value is displayed

requirements.description: Test rest duration varies by day
steps_to_verify: Verify Day 1 workouts have rest: 60
Verify Day 2 workouts have rest: 90
Verify Day 3 workouts have rest: 120

requirements.description: Test skip and pause timer functionality
steps_to_verify: Render rest timer state
Test skip button ends rest immediately
Test pause button stops countdown
Test resume continues countdown

requirements.description: Test ProgressScreen displays weeks and days
steps_to_verify: Render ProgressScreen with mock workout data
Verify 6 weeks are displayed
Verify completed days show checkmark
Verify current day is highlighted

requirements.description: Test completion percentage calculation
steps_to_verify: Render ProgressScreen with 3 completed workouts
Verify completion shows ~17% (3/18)
Test with 9 workouts shows ~50%

requirements.description: Test repeat week suggestion logic
steps_to_verify: Complete workout with 3+ failed sets
Verify repeat suggestion is displayed
Verify 'Powtórz tydzień' button appears

requirements.description: Test week attempt tracking
steps_to_verify: Verify weekAttempts increments on repeat
Verify attempt number displays correctly
Test previous attempt reps are shown

requirements.description: Test BottomNav navigation
steps_to_verify: Render BottomNav component
Verify 3 navigation buttons exist
Test clicking each button calls onNavigate
Verify active state styling

requirements.description: Test HomeScreen displays workout preview
steps_to_verify: Render HomeScreen with user data
Verify greeting shows Stefan's name
Verify current week and day are displayed
Verify next workout details are shown

requirements.description: Test CSS is properly linked
steps_to_verify: Verify index.html contains stylesheet link
Verify theme-color meta tag matches design

requirements.description: Compact done series display: '1: 28' instead of 'Seria 1: 28'
steps_to_verify: Start a workout and complete a set
Verify completed series shows '1: 28' format
Verify 'Seria' prefix is removed from series list

requirements.description: Reps input and target indicator displayed inline on same line
steps_to_verify: Start a workout
Verify input field and '/ {target}' are on the same line
Verify layout is horizontal: [input] / 35
Verify no line break between input and target indicator

requirements.description: Progress screen fits phone screen without scrolling
steps_to_verify: Open progress screen on mobile device
Verify all 6 weeks are visible without scrolling
Verify chart takes less vertical space
Verify week cards are compact (horizontal layout for days)
Verify chart X-axis labels are readable (not cramped)

requirements.description: Session totals displayed inside week boxes instead of chart
steps_to_verify: Open progress screen
Verify session totals (e.g., 29, 35, 41) appear inside each day indicator in week boxes
Verify totals are removed from the chart area above
Verify week boxes show both completion status and rep totals for each day

requirements.description: Initial test screen fits phone screen without scrolling
steps_to_verify: Open app for first time or retake test from settings
Verify initial test screen fits within phone viewport
Verify all elements (instructions, input, button) visible without scrolling
Verify layout is compact with reduced padding/margins

requirements.description: Remove progress bar chart from progress screen
steps_to_verify: Open progress screen
Verify the horizontal progress bar with T1D1 labels is removed
Verify week boxes remain as the main progress visualization
Verify screen has more vertical space for week cards
